events.name: Lagos Flash Flood
events.headline: Intense morning core over Apapa/Mile 2; 62 media reports; radar pass during rain

events.name: Lagos Flood 2011
events.headline: ~16 h of rain, two 44–46 mm/h cores (IMERG); morning core on a rising tide; 20–25 deaths (NEMA, Vanguard). #1 in rainfall scan

events.name: Alimosho Flood 2022
events.headline: Two days of citywide rain on wet ground (AOI 70 + 41 mm); cores at high tide; NEMA: seven dead in Alimosho. pwr #2

events.name: Lagos Flood Aug 2025
events.headline: ~13 h overnight rain, 120–160 mm Lekki/Island/Ikorodu; peak on a weak high tide. Homes submerged in Ijede/Ikorodu. pwr #21

events.name: Lekki/VI Flood 2017
events.headline: Street flooding in Lekki/VI on Sat 8 Jul (CNN), two days after the IMERG candidate. Rank #20

events.name: Lagos Island Flood 2021
events.headline: ~12 h rain, 90–105 mm citywide; peak on a falling tide. Marina, Lekki, Ajah flooded. NiMet gauges for validation. pwr #25
